heroTitle: Turning vague problems into verifiable systems.
heroBody: I’m Fish, a long-term system builder who connects quantitative research, data intelligence, and enterprise AI through engineering experience. I believe true sophistication in technology doesn’t come from stacking buzzwords but from evidence, boundaries, and sustained compounding returns.
focusBody: Quantitative research, retrieval-augmented intelligence, and data products that survive contact with reality.
writingBody: Notes from building, testing, breaking, and rebuilding intelligent systems.
projectBody: Three projects share a modest little server, and the same principle: keep complex capabilities understandable, runnable, and verifiable.
